messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Great! I've successfully added 2 GB of data to your line (555-123-2002). The $4.00 charge has been added to your current bill.

Now, since you're in France (outside your home network), you need to enable data roaming on your phone itself. Currently, your network status shows that data roaming is off on your device.

Please use the `toggle_roaming` command on your phone to turn data roaming ON.

After you do that, let me know what your network status shows, and we can test your data connection to ensure you're getting excellent speeds.

I have turned data roaming ON. The status bar now shows excellent signal with 5G network and mobile data enabled. What should I do next?

Please explain the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
